actual_adaptive_result: manual sparse execution on active rows

comparators.analytic: strongest transition-independent fixed-depth mixture at exact total adaptive FLOPs
comparators.histogram: within-episode permutation preserving each exact call histogram
comparators.seeded: preseeded integer fixed-depth mixture rounded to weakly more total FLOPs

contact_and_privileged_fields: never loaded into model, gate, stopping, whitening, exclusion, or decision statistics; contact may only be interpreted post hoc
dense_execution: separately accounted all-exit shadow for comparators and numerical equivalence only
latency: post-analysis synchronized latent/action-input through base prediction and full sparse path; reported separately and cannot affect statistical/FLOP verdict

statistics.simultaneous_interval: Bonferroni familywise-95% one-sided percentile lower bounds for the two fixed co-primary endpoints: each uses alpha/2 = 0.025; valid without commensurate units or dependence assumptions
statistics.stagewise_rank: Spearman score/gain rho >0 at every reached stage; scipy average ranks
statistics.strict_pass: every individual lower bound >0 and both simultaneous lower bounds >0

unblinding: only after exactly 300 raw episodes plus all sparse traces and dense shadows complete and their input seal is durable
